verdict.summary: Fairly close to easy for a future AI to work in. Guard rails are good (npm run check is the full local gate; MCP docs are tested against code; README map is current). 17 safe steps in 4 pull requests, about 16 thread-hours; none changes what a person sees or does.
reasons: convex/restApi.ts is 10,135 lines: the whole API-key door (33 route families, ~120 helpers), and some helpers were already copied into the one handler split out.
Rules written in more than one place: value lists typed by hand in five places; the loose movable-unit rule twice; CSV export in six screens; photo-link fetching in twelve components.

Misleading names: mcpPlanning.ts is the whole canonical door; mcpToolsCanonicalQueue.ts serves the legacy door; two files named restApi.ts; move-pages/ mixes live pages with redirected leftovers; one feature carries several names across routes, tables and tools.
